Title: Strike with Conviction and Spirit Marionette

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
If I steal an Imbued with Spirit Marionette, can I force him to bleed
with his Strike with Conviction?

Messages.Author: invisibl...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> If I steal an Imbued with Spirit Marionette, can I force him to bleed
> with his Strike with Conviction?

I would think so. Control of that imbued changes for the duration of
the action, so you decide how he bleeds. The imbued should be able to
use SWC for the same reason that a vampire with Dominate who's
Marionetted can use Dominate cards to bleed with.

John Eno

I think the question really is coming from the thought that Strike's
text doesn't indicate 'the controller of this vampire may burn this
card to do x', only:

"Burn to bleed at +1 bleed as a (D) action."

Taking control of the minion includes taking control of all the minion
cards on that minion (according to this LSJ post:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/02c1c87c1624d38b
)

However, Conviction cards specifically aren't minion cards, so does
control of a Conviction card on a minion also change when the control
of the minion changes?

-John Flournoy
